notes: Build79 Diagnostic Minimal Runtime is the first controlled reactivation after the Chrome-wide freeze incident. The shipped extension has no background service worker, no permissions, no host_permissions, no optional permissions, no network runtime, no storage runtime, no polling, no MutationObserver, no Composer Guardian, no Composer Bridge, and no Builds70-76 execution modules. A single document_idle content script runs only on lovable.dev and subdomains, mounts one Shadow DOM host with a local FAB and diagnostic panel, and registers only one click listener plus an optional one-shot DOMContentLoaded listener. The dormant update-manager artifact remains unreferenced by the manifest and cannot execute. This build exists solely to test whether minimal DOM injection is stable before any functional module is restored.
